Talent0_2Ability.name: Battlefield Veteran
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: After being attacked, if HP falls below <color=#F74848>50%</color>, triggers <color=#F74848>1</color> repair effect from equipped backpack after combat, and gains <buf ID=1016502>[Invigorate I]</buf> based on loss HP. Every <color=#F74848>10%</color> lost HP grants <color=#F74848>1</color> stack, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Battlefield Veteran
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
After being attacked, if HP falls below <color=#F74848>50%</color>, triggers <color=#F74848>1</color> repair effect from equipped backpack after combat, and gains <buf ID=1016502>[Invigorate I]</buf> based on loss HP. Every <color=#F74848>10%</color> lost HP grants <color=#F74848>1</color> stack, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks.
Repair effect from talent can restore <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. When attacking, gains <buf ID=1016514>[Unyielding Will]</buf>

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101602.name: Battlefield Repair
101602.describe: Restores HP of all parts of an ST for <color=#F74848>1.6</color> Repair AMT of the equipped backpack. Can restore <color=#F74848>1</color> destroyed part. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900127>[Invigorate]</buf>, the Repair multiplier is increased by <color=#F74848>+0.1</color>.

101603.name: Feigning Weakness
101603.SpecificEffects: In combat, if own HP percentage is less than enemy, critical hit chance and critical hit damage are increased by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

101604.name: Double-Edged Saw
101604.describe:
Uses a Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.35</color> DMG. This attack always hits the body part.
Before combat, reduces own HP by <color=#F74848>20%</color> of max HP, then deals <color=#F74848>20%</color> of target max HP as <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf>. The HP reduction as well as the <buf ID=900017>[固定伤害]</buf> cannot destroy any part.

101605.name: High Spirits
101605.SpecificEffects: When talent repair effect is triggered, dispels <color=#F74848>1</color> debuff from this unit.

101606.name: Decisive Strike
101606.describe: Uses a Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.8</color> DMG. For each <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=900127>[Invigorate]</buf>, increases the DMG multiplier by <color=#F74848>+0.15</color>.

101607.name: Counter-Attack Master
101607.SpecificEffects: During enemy turn, increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>15%</color>, reduces DMG taken by <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

101608.name: Desperate Measure
101608.describe: Reduces own HP by <color=#F74848>50%</color> of max HP, this effect cannot destroy part. Gains <color=#F74848>3</color> AP and <buf ID=7100901>[Movement UP]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Then triggers <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf> with full movement.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100031.name: Alacrity 1
100031.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack with a Melee Weapon, there is a <color=#F74848>20%</color> chance to trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> following the enemy’s attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100034.name: Alacrity 2
100034.SpecificEffects: Before an Active Attack, the probability of triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile moved, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.

100035.name: Alacrity 3
100035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.75</color>.

100036.name: Alacrity 4
100036.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf>, prioritize hitting the part with the lowest HP.

101641.name: Islander 1
101641.SpecificEffects: When attacked while equipping a Chainsaw, triggers <buf ID=900008>[Pursuit]</buf> after combat, automatically moving <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles toward the attacker. If successfully reached the target, uses Chainsaw to launch a <buf ID=900009>[Pursuit Retaliation]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.8</color> DMG. Returns to original position after trigger.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101644.name: Islander 2
101644.SpecificEffects: At the end of action, if <buf ID=900127>[Invigorate]</buf> stacks are <color=#F74848>5</color> or more, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

101646.name: Islander 4
101646.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900127>[Invigorate]</buf> maximum stacks increase by <color=#F74848>3</color>, each stack additionally increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>4%</color>.

hiddenSkills.name: Critical Strike
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Chainsaw to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.25x</color> DMG. This attack always hits the part with lowest HP.
